source: LRO LOLA 5 m/px south-polar DEM mosaic (ldem_87s_5mpp), Barker et al. 2021, NASA PGDA
citation: Barker et al., 2021, Planetary & Space Science 203, 105119, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119
crs: South polar stereographic, MOON_ME / DE421, R=1737400 m, lat_0=-90, lon_0=0, k0=1. x=rho*sin(lon), y=rho*cos(lon), rho=2R tan(pi/4+lat/2).
format: heightmap.bin: 256x256 Float32 little-endian, row-major, row 0 = north, col 0 = west, values = surface height Z in metres (MOON_ME). heightmap_lola.bin is the same grid without procedural craters.

craters.sfd: N(>D)=0.0035*(D/m)^(-2.7) per m^2, D=0.6–8 m (Neukum-like small-crater SFD); bowl d/D=0.08–0.20 by freshness
craters.note: Added on top of LOLA; not measured. LOLA already contains relief at ≥5–10 m.
